purpose: legislators:PK:Punjab:general seats for constituencies PP-101 to PP-150
query: List the CURRENT members of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab (Punjab, Pakistan) holding the general seats for constituencies PP-101 to PP-150, as of 2026-11-15. For each member give full name, constituency code and name (for constituency seats), seat type (general, women_reserved, minority_reserved, other_reserved), party name and acronym, term start, whether the seat was won in a by-election, and source URLs that list this person as a member for this seat. Account for by-elections, deaths, resignations and disqualifications since the general election; omit vacant seats.

members.full_name: Sardar Alhaj Ghulam Ahmad Khan Gadi

text: Current PP-101–PP-150 general-seat roster as of 2026-11-15 (50 occupied seats). Five current holders won by-elections: PP-115, PP-116, PP-139, PP-147 and PP-149. The assembly’s bulk contact directory still lists the superseded members for PP-115 and PP-116; the November 2025 election notifications and oath reporting establish their replacements. A year-only term start means the precise membership date was not established in the cited directory.
